admission_or_exclusion_reason: The historical work used JCM 1403 and measured a ColH collagenase able to degrade native collagen; the type-strain registry links JCM 1403 to NCTC 503 and its assembly. Reassay the deposited strain under the locked protocol; this row is not an observation.

LasB is a broad extracellular metalloprotease: published PAO1 work finds prominent fibronectin and vitronectin degradation with limited type-I-collagen degradation. It is a genetic specificity control, not an expected phenotype-negative control; independently scan the exact assembly for M9 evidence before scoring.

The paper reports cleavage of native collagen but no deposited assembly for CIP 82.01 was established. Do not replace it with the sequenced ATCC 17749 type strain: a species-level substitute would violate the strain--assembly contract.
